Great find up the stairs!
Jan 2018 • Couples
Walking down Đông Khoi there’s so many European restaurants, and that’s really not what we came to Vietnam to eat. I’m still not tired of eating Vietnamese food! So we saw this little poster on a bright orange wall leading up a narrow hallway, the poster featured a beautifully photographed meal, and up the stairs we went. Delicious food in a lovely space with beautiful decor. Cost for lunch including drinks was under 400,000 for 2 starters and 2 mains. Air conditioned and serene, I would try and find this little gem if you can!

Minh-Anh Quach
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam166 contributions

Clean authentic Vietnamese food
Oct 2017 • Couples
The speciality here is the “banh da cua” from Hai Phong. Previous reviewers said the broth was bland... but somehow it’s the way Northern Vietnamese cook. Also you need to squeeze some lemon juice to add some kick to your broth, which is provided. Fish sauce is also at disposals if u think it is under seasoned. Many office workers come here for lunch, so better book in advance if you want to avoid waiting. Other dishes are available, which looked very good from our table neighbors. The spring rolls were good, crunchy and tasty. The owner is VERY attentive to customers service. All come at a reasonable price.
